minGap: sets the residual bumper-to-bumper gap
accel / decel / emergencyDecel: set the closing and braking envelope

identifiability_notes.accel: constrained by the positive acceleration tail
identifiability_notes.decel: constrained by the negative acceleration tail and P2 closing episodes
identifiability_notes.minGap: weakly constrained: the observed low-gap tail is also affected by tau and decel
identifiability_notes.sigma: weakly constrained once tau and accel absorb the variance
identifiability_notes.tau: constrained by the net-gap distribution at given speeds
identifiability_notes.tau_minGap_decel: partially compensating in the observed gap distribution

reasons: deterministic, low-dimensional and already exercised by the engineering baseline

few identifiable parameters keep the calibration traceable
risks: a static speed and gap fit can succeed while the transient closing response stays wrong
one optimal fit must never be reported as fully calibrated driver behaviour

following_model_options.structural_freeze_recommendation: freeze the car-following model structure before optimisation and optimise only the parameter vector, so a failed calibration is attributable

claimed_lane_structure_from_reference.note: derived from the approved state table lateral offsets and longitudinal ranges; a 5-lane mainline plus a short ramp/auxiliary group, not a uniform 3-lane corridor

options.name: Generic highway corridor with an approved traffic-state envelope

options.name: US-101 corresponding network with verified geometric evidence

supports: start calibration without blocking on geometry evidence
upgrade to option B without invalidating the measurement contract

evaluation_window_rules: declare a fixed evaluation window before running anything
drop the run-in period and keep a constant post-warm-up window
assign an event to the window it starts in; never extrapolate exposure past the last observation
right-censored events at the window end keep their observed confirmation and are reported as censored

invariants: a 0.2 s recording must never be relabelled as 100 ms evidence

options.rationale: recorded cadence matches the 100 ms formal observation semantics exactly
options.risk: coarser car-following integration than option B

options.rationale: finer integration while keeping 100 ms recorded evidence
options.risk: twice the simulation cost; the recorded series still cannot exceed 100 ms evidence

time_step_options.recommendation_reason: the recorded series keeps exact 100 ms formal observation semantics while the finer integration reduces the transient overshoot of the closing episodes; the measured convergence probe shows the event boundaries still move when the internal step is halved, so the internal step must be frozen as part of the measurement protocol
time_step_options.warmup_principle: fix the warm-up by a traffic-stability diagnostic (network inflow/flow and mean-speed stabilisation within a pre-declared tolerance window) rather than an arbitrary number of seconds; the diagnostic rule itself is a researcher decision
